about: The showroom's registry: one hub-site/1 entry per PUBLIC hosted site, live and checked. No private or vault-only site is ever listed here, not even by name or count. Each site's agent adds its own entry when the site goes live; tools/build-showroom.py builds site/index.html from it. Summaries are each site's own meta description.
